p: ye make an end of words: Who count yourselves just as Job 12:4.
mark: Whom you take to be only beasts, as in Job 12:7.
He teareth himself in his anger: That is, like a madman.
earth be forsaken for thee: Shall God change the order of nature for your sake, by dealing with you otherwise than he does with all man?
put out: When the wicked is in his prosperity, then God changes his state: and this is his ordinary working for their sins.
walketh upon a snare: Meaning, that the wicked are in continual danger.
hungerbitten: That which should nourish him will be consumed by famine.
firstborn of death shall devour his: That is, some strong and violent death will consume his strength: or as the Hebrew word signifies his members or parts.
king of terrors: That is, with great fear.
brimstone shall be scattered upon his: Though all the world would favour him, yet God would destroy him and his.
light into darkness: He will fall from prosperity to adversity.
day: When they will see what came to him.
